verdict: Ad efficiency holds steady; 7 overdue milestones now need resolution.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,503.88 in revenue on $1,429.99 in spend — a 3.85x return that has held flat week-over-week, with purchases unchanged and efficiency nudging up 2.43%. Instagram reach grew 21.27% this past week, which is a positive signal for organic visibility. Seven planned milestones — including funnel setup, automation flows, and subscribe pages — are past their due dates, and clearing those is the priority work underway now, as they underpin the next phase of growth. Google Business Profile actions dipped 27.91% this week; we're investigating whether this reflects a data reporting gap or a genuine drop in local discovery, and will confirm by next report.
